data.name: Hellmarch
data.detailed_description:
The world lies in ruins, overrun by Hell’s merciless legions. As the last spark of defiance, you stand alone against an endless tide of evil. Wield your power, carve through the darkness, and reclaim what’s been lost in a relentless battle for humanity’s soul.

Hellmarch is a 3D isometric roguelite auto-shooter born from a solo developer’s passion. Face swarms of grotesque enemies, level up your abilities, and dance through deadly bullet storms in a raw, heart-pounding fight for survival. Every run is a fresh chance to grow stronger, adapt, and strike back.

Features

  • Gothic Nightmare: Plunge into a haunting dark fantasy world where twisted abominations lurk in every shadow. From crumbling cathedrals to cursed wastelands, the atmosphere drips with dread.

  • Legendary Heroes: Recruit a diverse cast of champions, from battle-scarred knights to arcane outcasts, each with unique skills that change how you wage war. Find the hero who fits your style and turn the tide.

  • Divine Power: Discover sacred Relics scattered across the chaos—ancient artifacts that supercharge your abilities with devastating effects. Mix and match to unleash apocalyptic combos that shred your foes.

  • Frenzied Combat: Embrace the thrill of high-speed battles, weaving through bullet barrages while mowing down demonic hordes. Every fight is a glorious, visual explosion of chaos and strategy.

  • Easy to Play: Jump in with simple, intuitive controls that let you focus on the action. No steep learning curve—just pure, unfiltered carnage from the first minute.

  • Quick Hits: Each 10-minute run is a self-contained thrill ride, packed with tough choices and escalating intensity. Perfect for a quick dive or hours of chasing the perfect build.

Built with Unreal Engine 5, Hellmarch delivers breathtaking visuals, from grotesque enemy designs to fiery particle effects, all optimized to run butter-smooth at 60 FPS on Steam Deck.

data.short_description: HELLMARCH is a relentless, dark fantasy horde-survival game where you wield divine power against the legions of the damned. Hellmarch drops you into the heart of a doomed world, armed with nothing but holy wrath. Survive waves of undead, demons, and heretics in a grim battle between Heaven and Hell.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
